safety_designation: RESEARCH DEMONSTRATION PROTOTYPE — NOT FOR LIFE SAFETY

state_machine_defect_status.description: Omission of 'else: active_cluster = []' in model_phase17.py causes retention of unconfirmed qualifying spikes across arbitrary time gaps; unguarded EOF flush emits trailing single spikes.

animal_suppression_audit_status.counterfactual_reproducibility: 11/25 confirmed direct causal contribution to fragmentation, 9/25 pure acoustic, 5/25 partial

governance_decision.rationale: Phase 17 possesses a confirmed state-machine defect, exhibits lower specificity (+31 false alerts in negative continuous exposure), and demonstrates no statistically significant superiority on independent continuous audio.
